title.narrative: Eswatini PCB Project: PCB Use Phase Out and Elimination in Eswatini

description.narrative: The objective of the GEF PPG is to develop the project concept into a full project: Reduced risks to human health and the environment through the phase-out and environmentally sound management (ESM) of PCB-containing equipment and waste in Eswatini. The project aims to ensure the elimination of PCB-containing equipment and waste in line with Stockholm Convention targets for 2025 and 2028. The project will focus on strengthening national policies and regulatory frameworks for PCB phase-out, completing and verifying PCB inventories, replacing PCB-containing transformers and capacitors, and ensuring the environmentally sound disposal of PCB-contaminated materials. Additionally, the project will engage key stakeholders, including the private sector, to promote compliance, co-financing, and investment in PCB-free technologies. The final outputs of the project will include updated policies and regulations for PCB management, a comprehensive and verified national PCB inventory, and a national PCB tracking and reporting system.

condition.narrative: The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
